listening.title: Phỏng vấn: Giới thiệu bản thân

lines.speaker: Ngọc (interviewer)
lines.text: Good morning, Minh. Let's start—can you introduce yourself?

lines.speaker: Minh (candidate)
lines.text: Good morning. Sure. Let me start with my educational background.

lines.speaker: Minh (candidate)
lines.text: I graduated in Computer Science and have a relevant qualification in software testing too.

lines.speaker: Ngọc (interviewer)
lines.text: Great. Can you tell me about your present position?

lines.speaker: Minh (candidate)
lines.text: In my present position, I lead a small team of three developers at a fintech company.

lines.speaker: Ngọc (interviewer)
lines.text: Interesting. What would you say is your professional journey so far?

lines.speaker: Minh (candidate)
lines.text: My professional journey started as a tester before I moved into development.

lines.speaker: Ngọc (interviewer)
lines.text: What's one core skill you bring to this position?

lines.speaker: Minh (candidate)
lines.text: One of my core skills is solving problems under pressure.

lines.speaker: Ngọc (interviewer)
lines.text: And what's a notable achievement you're proud of?

lines.speaker: Minh (candidate)
lines.text: My most notable achievement was launching an app two weeks ahead of schedule.
